name: EDHEC Business School
summary: Business school in Lille and Nice; a four-year International BBA taught in English (or French), plus a double BSc with King's College London.

ib.text: The IB Diploma is accepted (not IB certificates or the CP); no minimum points stated. EDHEC advises maths, science, economics or humanities subjects.

apply.via: EDHEC's own portal (BBA); UCAS for the King's BSc

dates.label: Round 1 closes; online interviews 26 Nov–8 Dec, results 17 December
Round 2 closes; interviews 28 Jan–9 Feb, results 18 February
Round 3 closes; interviews 4–16 March, results 25 March
Round 4 closes; interviews 26 April–5 May, results 20 May
Round 5 (last) closes; interviews 21–27 June, results 2 July

programmes.name: Business Management Track
programmes.about: A flexible four-year management degree taught in English or French from the first year, with a sector specialisation, internships and time abroad.
programmes.selectionNote: Transcripts, CV and personal statement, then an online English assessment, the Emage-me personality app and an online interview.

family.name: International BBA
family.differs: Lille or Nice, in English or French; €15,900 a year.

programmes.name: Global Business Track
programmes.about: Year 1 at EDHEC in Nice, year 2 at UCLA Extension in Los Angeles and year 3 at Nanyang Technological University in Singapore, with long internships; taught in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Transcripts, CV and personal statement, then an online English assessment, the Emage-me personality app and an online interview.

family.name: International BBA
family.differs: Nice, then UCLA Extension and NTU Singapore, in English; €23,900 a year.

programmes.name: International Business Analytics and Management BSc
programmes.about: A double degree with King's Business School, taught entirely in English: business analytics and international management, studied in London and in Lille.
programmes.ib: Apply through UCAS by 13 January 2027, 19:00 (UTC+1), not EDHEC's own rounds.

notes: Five BBA rounds run from October to June; the €100 application fee applies and a €5,000 deposit secures a place.
All BBA tracks lead to the same Bachelor in Business Administration diploma.
EU students pay King's international fee for the two London years of the double BSc.
